datasetMetadata.name: ResolveIQ Incident Classification & Duplicate Detection Benchmark Dataset
datasetMetadata.description: Curated ground-truth operational incidents across 6 ITIL categories, 5 priority tiers, and 5 SRE teams, along with positive and negative duplicate incident pairs.
datasetMetadata.limitations: Lexical TF-IDF relies on token overlap; purely conceptual synonyms without vocabulary overlap require hybrid semantic or LLM augmentation. The benchmark size reflects an initial deterministic validation baseline.

incidents.title: 504 Gateway Timeout on Ingress Envoy Edge Pods
incidents.description: Customer traffic experiencing intermittent 504 gateway timeouts across edge envoy proxy pods with connection pool exhaustion.

incidents.title: Severe P99 Response Latency Spike on Checkout API
incidents.description: Checkout service API p99 latency increased from 180ms to 4200ms following high query volume. Users experiencing checkout hangs.

incidents.title: PostgreSQL Write Replica Replication Lag Exceeding 180s
incidents.description: Database replica replication stream lag exceeded 180 seconds. Read traffic serving stale order snapshots.

incidents.title: Duplicate Ledger Billing Entries Detected After Stripe Webhook Retry
incidents.description: Financial ledger recorded duplicate transaction entries due to idempotent key mismatch during webhook redelivery.

incidents.title: Unauthorized 401 Tokens on IAM OAuth2 Provider
incidents.description: JWT signature verification failing across microservices due to expired public key rotation in IAM keycloak cluster.

incidents.title: Kubernetes Worker Node Disk Pressure and Pod Eviction
incidents.description: Worker node k8s-worker-09 reported disk full on root filesystem. Container runtime evicting pods.

incidents.title: Failed Helm Release Rollout on Core API Pods
incidents.description: Deployment pipeline failed during rollout v2.4.1 due to invalid container image tag in deployment manifest.

incidents.title: Redis Cache Cluster Node Outage and Eviction Spike
incidents.description: Redis master node crashed unexpectedly with OOM error. Cache misses overloading primary database.

incidents.title: Elevated API Latency Due to Unindexed Mongo Query
incidents.description: Slow query logs indicate full collection scans on orders collection leading to sluggish response times.

incidents.title: Checksum Mismatch on Nightly S3 Parquet Data Sync
incidents.description: Nightly data warehouse sync identified checksum divergence and missing records between primary and analytical tables.

incidents.title: Expired SSL Certificate on Edge CDN Ingress Domain
incidents.description: Browsers warning of expired SSL certificate on public edge cdn endpoint api.resolveiq.io.

incidents.title: High CPU Throttle on Kubernetes DaemonSet Monitoring Agent
incidents.description: Prometheus node-exporter consuming excessive CPU cycles causing node-level scheduling contention.

incidents.title: Cloudflare CDN Cache Purge Pipeline 502 Bad Gateway
incidents.description: Automated deployment cache invalidator receiving 502 bad gateway from cloudflare management API.

incidents.title: Payment Card Token Decryption Service Latency Degradation
incidents.description: Card tokenization decrypt RPC endpoint experiencing 3500ms p95 latency under high concurrency.

incidents.title: Session Store Invalidation Causing 403 Forbidden Access Errors
incidents.description: Redis session store cluster evictions invalidating active responder tokens resulting in 403 forbidden.

incidents.title: Database Connection Pool Starvation on Postgres Cluster
incidents.description: Application servers exhausted max_connections on primary postgres database leading to connection timeouts.

incidents.title: Rollback Triggered by Automated Canary Analysis on Ingress Envoy
incidents.description: Canary deployment v3.2.0 automated rollback triggered after canary pods recorded 1.5% error rate.

incidents.title: Corrupt User Profile Table Indices Following Migration Script
incidents.description: Database migration v44 created corrupted index entries causing query crashes and data inconsistency.

incidents.title: Network Packet Drop Spike on Kubernetes Calico CNI
incidents.description: Calico CNI iptables lock contention causing 12% packet drop rate between microservice pods.

incidents.title: Service Mesh Envoy Sidecar Outage on Billing Namespace
incidents.description: Istio envoy sidecar proxies crashed on billing pods resulting in complete service outage.

incidents.title: Slow Payment Webhook Acknowledgement Latency
incidents.description: Webhook notification dispatcher lagging by 45 seconds causing partner retry storms.

incidents.title: Continuous Deployment Helm Chart Release Failure
incidents.description: ArgoCD synchronization failed on payments service due to invalid k8s resource schema.

incidents.title: Credential Leak Warning on Internal Logging Elastic Cluster
incidents.description: Debug log aggregator observed logging plaintext bearer tokens in access log streams.

incidents.title: Storage Volume EBS IOPS Exhaustion on Database Host
incidents.description: AWS EBS gp3 storage volume throttled at burst IOPS limit causing severe filesystem lock contention.
